quote.text: For I am not everlasting, but a human being, a part of the whole as an hour is a part of the day. Like an hour I must come, and like an hour pass away.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that, like the fleeting hour, each moment with your children is transient; cherish every smile and lesson, understanding that life's impermanence deepens its value.
    • Cultivate patience and acceptance when challenges arise; knowing that time will pass, you have the unique power to instill wisdom and resilience in your children for their journey ahead.
  • Leadership
    • Embrace the transient nature of your authority to empower your team; see your role as a guide who shapes enduring values rather than clinging to fleeting accolades.
    • Let the awareness of your own mortality inspire empathy and humility in your leadership; it encourages you to leave a legacy built on ethical decisions and genuine human connections.
  • Product Management
    • Understand that both successes and setbacks are temporary; use this insight to iterate on ideas rapidly and remain resilient in the face of evolving market demands.
    • Focus on creating products that deliver lasting value rather than chasing momentary trends; by acknowledging the impermanence of each phase, you can build solutions that endure and evolve gracefully.
